title: Determining the Drivers of Public Participation in Environmental Governance Using AI
The Effects of Storage on Water Price Sensitivity to Droughts
AMI Water Meters Deliver End-Use Water and Financial Savings in Leaky Households: Experimental Evidence from California
abstract: Advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) for residential water consumption is exploding globally giving water utilities the ability to improve their water tracking, billing, and distribution systems’ leak detection. With AMI, utilities have also gained the opportunity to provide real-time high-resolution water consumption information to their customers to induce conservation. Using a randomized controlled trial we find that on average homes that install AMI and receive conservation based messaging significantly reduce water consumption by 5.24 gallons per household per day beyond savings already obtained from home water reports. Of the estimated water savings we attribute 92.8% to leak reduction. While the payback period from the deployment of AMI meters and treatment in all homes is over 41 years, homes that experience leaks realize financial savings of $60/year and a treatment payback period of four years. This is because treatment did not induce water or financial savings in homes without leaks. These findings indicate that even on top of existing conservation programs, AMI messaging that targets end-user leaks could result in significant water savings, economic benefits to end-users, and advance conservation goals.
abstract_zh: 居民用水的高级计量基础设施（AMI）正在全球范围内迅速普及，使供水公司能够改进其用水追踪、计费以及配水系统的漏损检测。借助AMI，供水公司还获得了向用户提供实时、高分辨率用水信息以促进节约的机会。通过一项随机对照试验，我们发现，平均而言，安装了AMI并接收节水信息的家庭，在已有家庭用水报告所带来的节水效果之外，每户每天显著减少用水5.24加仑。在估计的节水量中，我们将92.8%归因于漏水减少。尽管在所有家庭中部署AMI计量表和干预措施的投资回收期超过41年，但存在漏水的家庭每年可实现60美元的经济节约，干预措施的投资回收期为四年。这是因为，干预措施在不存在漏水的家庭中并未带来用水或经济上的节约。这些发现表明，即使在现有节水项目之上，针对终端用户漏水的AMI信息传递，也能带来显著的节水效果、给终端用户带来经济效益，并推动节水目标的实现。

title: Designing Water Markets for Climate Change Adaptation
The Dynamic Impacts of Pricing Groundwater
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper evaluates own-price dynamics in taxing environmental externalities. We exploit a natural experiment that exposed some firms to a large and persistent price increase for groundwater, a setting characterized by incomplete markets. Using five years of post-treatment data on farm-level water use, we find that water conservation doubles between the first and fifth year of the tax. Failure to account for dynamics in policies designed to manage groundwater will mischaracterize the price elasticity of demand and introduce efficiency costs.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了对环境外部性征税中的自身价格动态效应。我们利用一项自然实验，该实验使部分企业面临地下水价格大幅且持续上涨，而这一情境的特点是市场不完全。利用五年征税后的农场层面用水数据，我们发现，水资源节约量在征税第一年与第五年之间翻了一番。若在旨在管理地下水的政策中忽视动态效应，将会错误刻画需求的价格弹性，并带来效率损失。

title: Untapped Potential: Leak Reduction is the Most Cost-effective Urban Water Management Tool
abstract: Providing sufficient, safe, and reliable drinking water is a growing challenge as water supplies become more scarce and uncertain. Meanwhile, water utilities in the United States lose approximately 17% of their delivered water to leaks each year. Using data from over 800 utilities across four U.S. states, California, Georgia, Tennessee, and Texas, we characterize the heterogeneity in water losses across the U.S., develop a model to assess the economically efficient level of losses, and use this model to compare the net benefits of several proposed water loss regulations and modeling approaches. Combining economic and engineering principles, our model shows that for the median utility, it is economically efficient to reduce water losses by 34.7%, or 100 acre-feet (AF) per year. The median cost of water savings from leak management is $277/AF, which falls well below the cost of traditional water management tools. However, the optimal level of water losses strongly depends on utility-specific characteristics, leading to large differences in the potential for cost-effective leak reduction across utilities. We show that water loss management can lead to water savings that generate net economic benefits, but only if management approaches incorporate economic and engineering principles.
abstract_zh: 随着水资源日益稀缺且不确定，提供充足、安全和可靠的饮用水正成为一项日益严峻的挑战。与此同时，美国的供水公司每年因漏损而损失的供水量约占其供水总量的17%。利用来自加利福尼亚州、佐治亚州、田纳西州和得克萨斯州四个美国州的800多家供水公司的数据，我们刻画了美国各地水损失的异质性，构建了一个评估经济效率意义上最优漏损水平的模型，并利用该模型比较了若干拟议的水损失监管措施和建模方法的净效益。结合经济学与工程学原理，我们的模型表明，对于中位数供水公司而言，将水损失减少34.7%（即每年100英亩英尺，AF）在经济上是有效率的。漏损管理带来的节水成本中位数为每英亩英尺277美元，远低于传统水资源管理工具的成本。然而，最优漏损水平在很大程度上取决于各供水公司的特征，这导致不同公司在具有成本效益的漏损削减潜力上存在巨大差异。我们表明，水损失管理可以带来产生净经济效益的节水效果，但前提是管理方法必须融合经济学与工程学原理。

title: Climate Change and California Agriculture
Missing Markets: Evidence on Agricultural Groundwater Demand From Volumetric Pricing
Residential Water Conservation During Drought: Experimental Evidence from Three Behavioral Interventions
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper deploys a framed field experiment and uses high-frequency data to evaluate the short- and long-run effects of three behavioral interventions on residential water use during extreme drought. Our study of the effects of Home Water Reports (HWRs) on hourly water use yields three main results. First, even when layered on top of a 25% drought conservation mandate, HWRs led to conservation effects of 4 to 5%. Second, across three variants of HWRs, the profile of water conservation is similar, suggesting that households did not respond to the messaging or recommendations contained in the HWRs. Third, the water conservation effect of all interventions dissipated five months after the intervention ended. In our setting, these behavioral interventions align with utility incentives to achieve immediate but temporary water conservation in response to drought.
abstract_zh: 干旱期间的居民节水：来自三种行为干预的实验证据。本文利用框架化的田间实验和高频数据，评估了三种行为干预在极端干旱期间对居民用水的短期和长期效应。我们对“家庭用水报告”（Home Water Reports，HWRs）对每小时用水量影响的研究得出三项主要结果。第一，即使叠加在 25% 的干旱节水强制令之上，HWRs 仍带来了 4% 至 5% 的节水效果。第二，在三种不同形式的 HWRs 中，节水效果的变化轨迹相似，这表明家庭并未对 HWRs 中包含的信息或建议做出回应。第三，所有干预的节水效果在干预结束五个月后消失殆尽。在我们的研究背景下，这些行为干预与公用事业公司的激励相一致，即在干旱时期实现即时但暂时的节水。

title: Spillovers from Behavioral Interventions: Experimental Evidence from Water and Energy Use
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper provides experimental evidence that behavioral interventions spill over to untreated sectors by altering consumer choice. We use a randomized controlled trial and high-frequency data to test the effect of social norms messaging about residential water use on electricity consumption. Messaging appears to induce a small reduction in summertime electricity use. Empirical tests and household survey data support the hypothesis that this nudge alters electricity choices. An engineering simulation suggests that complementarities between appliances that use water and electricity explain roughly a quarter of the electricity reduction. Incorporating the cross-sectoral spillover increases the net benefits of the intervention substantially.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了实验证据，表明行为干预会通过改变消费者选择而外溢至未受干预的领域。我们利用一项随机对照试验和高频数据，检验关于居民用水的社会规范信息传递对电力消费的影响。信息传递似乎使夏季用电量出现小幅下降。实证检验和家庭调查数据支持这一假设：这种助推改变了电力选择。一项工程模拟表明，使用水和电力的各类电器之间的互补性，可以解释大约四分之一的用电减少量。纳入这种跨部门溢出效应后，干预的净效益显著增加。

title: Using Price Elasticities of Water Demand to Inform Policy
abstract: This survey distills recent work on the price elasticity of demand for urban and agricultural water and outlines how it can inform the design of market-based approaches to manage increasingly scarce water resources. We offer a brief description of the water sector, including the primary users, main water sources, and market failures in the allocation and use of surface water and groundwater. A review of recent empirical research on the price elasticities of agricultural and urban water demand shows the progress made in our understanding of user response to prices and reveals substantial heterogeneity in the price response. We apply what we have learned about elasticities to surface water markets and price-based groundwater management. Heterogeneity in price elasticities suggests that water transfers may lead to large efficiency gains, but that their magnitude is site specific. Groundwater pricing may cost-effectively manage groundwater and fund the development of alternative water supplies, but heterogeneity in elasticity estimates highlights that the conservation and revenue generated are basin specific.
abstract_zh: 本综述梳理了近期关于城市和农业用水需求价格弹性的研究成果，并阐述了这些成果如何为设计以市场为基础的方法、管理日益稀缺的水资源提供依据。我们简要介绍了水务部门，包括主要用水者、主要水源以及地表水和地下水在配置与使用中的市场失灵问题。对近期农业与城市用水价格弹性实证研究的回顾表明，我们在理解用水者对价格的反应方面已取得进展，并揭示出价格反应存在显著的异质性。我们将所了解到的弹性知识应用于地表水市场和基于价格的地下水管理。价格弹性的异质性表明，水权转让可能带来巨大的效率收益，但其规模因地而异。地下水定价或许能以成本效益较高的方式管理地下水，并为替代供水的开发提供资金，但弹性估计值的异质性表明，节水效果与所产生的收入具有明显的流域特异性。

title: Utilities Included: Split Incentives in Commercial Electricity Contracts
abstract: This paper quantifies a tenant-side “split incentives” problem that exists when the largest commercial sector customers are on electricity-included property lease contracts, causing them to face a marginal electricity price of zero. We use exogenous variation in weather shocks to show that the largest firms on tenant-paid contracts use up to 14 percent less electricity in response to summer temperature fluctuations. The result is retrieved under weaker identifying assumptions than previous split incentives papers, and is robust when exposed to several opportunities to fail. The electricity reduction in response to temperature increases is likely to be a lower bound when generalized nationwide and suggests that policymakers should consider a sub-metering policy to expose the largest commercial tenants to the prevailing retail electricity price.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了一个租户方的“激励分离”问题，该问题存在于最大的商业部门客户签订包含电费在内的物业租赁合同时，使其面临的边际电价为零。我们利用天气冲击的外生变异表明，签订租户自付电费合同的最大企业，在夏季气温波动时用电量最多减少14%。该结果是在比以往激励分离研究更弱的识别假设下得出的，并且在多次可能被推翻的稳健性检验中保持稳健。若推广至全国，气温升高所引起的用电减少很可能是下限，这表明政策制定者应考虑实施分表计量政策，使最大的商业租户面对现行零售电价。

title: Electricity Prices, Groundwater and Agriculture: The Environmental and Agricultural Impacts of Electricity Subsidies in India
Climate Change and Labor Allocation in Rural Mexico: Evidence from Annual Fluctuations in Weather
abstract: This article evaluates the effects of annual fluctuations in weather on employment in rural Mexico to gain insight into the potential labour market implications of climate change. Using a 28‐year panel on individual employment, we find that years with a high occurrence of heat lead to a reduction in local employment, particularly for wage work and non‐farm labour. Extreme heat also increases migration domestically from rural to urban areas and internationally to the US. A medium emissions scenario implies that increases in extreme heat may decrease local employment by up to 1.4% and climate change may increase migration by 1.4%.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了墨西哥农村地区天气年度波动对就业的影响，以洞察气候变化可能对劳动力市场产生的影响。利用一个为期28年的个体就业面板数据，我们发现，高温频发的年份会导致当地就业减少，尤其是工资性工作和非农劳动。极端高温还会增加从农村向城市的国内迁移，以及向美国的国际迁移。在中等排放情景下，极端高温的增加可能使当地就业减少多达1.4%，而气候变化可能使迁移增加1.4%。

title: Utilization and Customer Behavior: Smart Choices for the Smart Grid
Commercial and Industrial Demand Response under Mandatory Time-of-Use Pricing
Knowledge is (Less) Power: Experimental Evidence from Residential Energy Use
abstract: Imperfect information about product attributes inhibits efficiency in many choice settings, but can be overcome by providing simple, low-cost information. We use a randomized control trial to test the effect of high-frequency information about residential electricity usage on the price elasticity of demand. Informed households are three standard deviations more responsive to temporary price increases, an effect that is not attributable to price salience. Conservation extends beyond pricing events in the short and medium run, providing evidence of habit formation and implying that the intervention leads to greenhouse gas abatement. Survey evidence suggests that information facilitates learning. (JEL D12, D83, L11, L94, Q41, Q54)
abstract_zh: 关于产品属性的信息不完全，会在许多选择场景中抑制效率，但通过提供简单、低成本的信息可以克服这一问题。我们利用随机对照试验，检验关于居民用电的高频信息对需求价格弹性的影响。获得信息的家庭对临时性价格上涨的反应强烈三个标准差，且这一效应并非源于价格显著性。节约行为在短期和中期内延续至定价事件之外，显示出习惯形成的证据，并表明该干预会带来温室气体减排。调查证据表明，信息有助于学习。（JEL D12, D83, L11, L94, Q41, Q54）

title: Development and the Environment: The Implications of Agricultural Electricity Subsidies in India
abstract: In India, the government provides agricultural electricity subsidies amounting to 85% of the average cost of supply to encourage agricultural production and economic growth, especially among the rural poor. However, these agricultural input subsidies may compromise environmental quality and have the potential to reduce agricultural output in the long run. This article provides an overview of these subsidies in India, detailing the rationale behind their introduction and their evolution over time. It then examines the benefits of the subsidies, notably a rise in agricultural productivity and an increase in rural incomes. In addition, it considers the environmental and economic costs of this policy: accelerated groundwater extraction, increased electricity usage and in turn greenhouse gas emissions, a contribution to the intermittent and low-quality electricity service characteristic of India, and potential impacts on industrial growth. The authors then broaden the lessons learned from electricity subsidies in India to other countries and contextualize these findings within the discussion on environment and development.
abstract_zh: 在印度，政府提供的农业电力补贴相当于平均供电成本的85%，旨在鼓励农业生产和经济增长，尤其是惠及农村贫困人口。然而，这些农业投入补贴可能损害环境质量，并可能在长期内降低农业产出。本文概述了印度的这些补贴，详细阐述了其推出的理由及随时间的演变。随后，本文考察了补贴的收益，尤其是农业生产率的提高和农村收入的增加。此外，本文还考虑了该政策的环境和经济成本：地下水过度抽取加速、电力使用增加进而导致温室气体排放上升、对印度间歇性且质量低下的电力供应所起的助长作用，以及对工业增长的潜在影响。作者随后将从印度电力补贴中汲取的经验教训推广至其他国家，并将这些发现置于环境与发展问题的讨论之中加以阐释。
